name: bot-train-power-start-fork
title: Bot Train Power Start Fork
description: Provides an infinity storage chest with infinite materials to set up bot, train and power networks when starting a new game. Bots are able to pick up and drop items from the chest. Provides: (elevated) rails, rail signals, train stops, locomotives, fluid and cargo wagons, pumps, substations, logistic chests, arithmetic/decider/selector/constant combinators, roboports, construction and logistic bots. If used with pY then mk01 equivalent equipment is provided instead.
